Results

pitch.understand: The job in itself is to be part of a team but also understand that as an individual you have lots to do for yourself and the team. The finish line is always changing, and each small step was the previous finish line, I can relate this to when you are creating something like a game or a book you have multiple steps to complete before reaching the end. The end can be the beginning of the next project.
pitch.offer: I believe that I bring organization and leadership to a team, I like to stay organized and make sure that we all can access what we need to and when we need to. Id say that my leadership skills are something that I can contribute, and have previously contributed in past projects. In the Slideshow, Lov3rs Plaza, and Sharksweeper projects I have been the team leader and have been in charge of setting up and distributing the work load to the correct individuals based on their skills. I had been in charge of managing the main repository making sure that assignments get done in time for submission.
pitch.limits: I think that my knowledge in coding would be classified as basic, meaning that I have been brushing up in my skills and trying more solo projects to further those skills. I think that understanding the code is important but so is understanding the story.
pitch.availability:
Preferred contact: Text
I dont have a set work schedule so somedays I open others I close, I can be contacted and can respond at any time
pitch.tools: Some of the most useful tools that I will be using are Youtube, Spotify and A.I such as Gemini and Chatgpt. I would say that these tools are important to me because I have learned so much from youtube, I dont have to stay with one way of understanding things because there is always another video that will teach it differently. Music is an important part of my life and Spotify helps me focus and create a mood for the project that I am working. A.I is one of the most powerful tools not only for this class but in general because it can help in areas that I am lacking and bounce ideas.
pitch.aiTool:
AI: Chat GPT and Gemini
Task: Serve as a pool of information where I can ask questions or for clarification.
Verification: I will not take it as face value but will ask for references and will look for other sources. I can relate to using AI with English and Math, I have used it to help me understand math concepts or to use example to clarify.

huddle.mission: We wanted to create a new type of game where we can combine minecraft mobs and creatures with pokemon balls
huddle.framework: My team a I choose P2P for the simple fact it will help us with the use of organized sources and will help us with the game engine setup.

Background: (Jonathan)
Learn the lore from both source materials (Minecraft and Pokemon). Build the world of minecraft, a free roam where the main character is a combination of Ash and Steve.

Assets: (Mio)
Assets: Getting the elements that will be edited and used in the creation of the mod: - Characters, text, animation, 3d models, fonts, audio, etc. Obtaining everything that will be used in order to achieve the results, aka also the things the audience will view.

Body Frame: (Isaias) 
Build/configure: Put the blocky world together, add an Ash-Steve character so he can walk around, and set up the basic controls for throwing Pokéballs and catching Pokémon as well of building like in a Minecraft world.

Output: (Daniel)
The output is for are mod to allow the player/consumer to be able to throw a poke ball to a Minecraft mob it will also make a custom world when loaded for the player with bits of Pokémon while still looking like Minecraft.

Results: (Paul)
Results - We have achieved the results we wanted. We wanted to make a mod pack for the video game Minecraft where we added a poke-ball from Pokemon.
